text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Would you like to have some tea together?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I went back home during my time off,
and the tea I had there smelled wonderful♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It helps you relax, and
I also recommend it for a good night's sleep,
so I really wanted you to have it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let the lovely tea time begin!
I'll go boil some water right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Satono Diamond had a wonderful, fulfilling day off!
